findings: Confirmed fallback selection loss under owned directory-at-settings-path fixture: save width901 falls back APPDATA, load continues preferring existing primary path, fails reading directory, defaults720 then overwrites APPDATA with720. Original module unchanged; fixture establishes IO-failure mechanism, not exact Windows ProgramFiles permission behavior.
Existing unreadable primary regularfile would also be selected by existence; failed read does not try fallback. Static generalization distinct from executed directory fixture.

Load backs corruptJSON to json.bak but ignores renamefailure; save directwrite and fallbackwrite errors not returned. Backup preservation conditional, not crash-atomic persistence. No real user settings touched.

Settings mutex scopes read before defaultsave to avoid selfdeadlock; save serializes inprocess IO, but load lock gap permits concurrent firstload/defaultsave overwriting another change. Static concurrency hypothesis, no multithread test.

AppSettings fields default individually but lack range validation for widths/fonts; normalized theme maps defaultDark toOmni. Defaults and normalizedtheme distinction, not renderedbug proof. Empty cfgtest module contains no test functions.

Logger fallback does not create APPDATAparent; if both openfail diagnostic disappears. Sizecheck+truncate comment callsatomic but metadata/set_len/write sequence not synchronized across calls; recordinterleaving/truncation races not reproduced.
README instant millions claims no benchmark evidence. Full index/search/Lite main still pending; no adoption from promotional description.
Build uses Slint compile and Windows icon/versionresources; Cargo lists Windows/SQLite/watcher/UI/network dependencies. No full Windowsbuild, dependencyresolution or performance claim.
